selection_rule: Eligibility on EACH trajectory: AbsRel and RMSE <=1.05x every; near AbsRel and RMSE <=1.10x every; no right-censored events; observed max update delay <=2 frames (zero-event case has no safety evidence). Among eligible minimize worst trajectory inference-call fraction, then worst normalized error across 4 metrics and both trajectories, then mean observed event delay (no-event trajectories omitted), then config id. If none eligible, select least constraint violation for diagnostic timing only and label infeasible.
matching: ceil(k*N/K), exactly K calls per trajectory, K chosen from selected adaptive validation calls; no GT-aligned phases
contract: Unchanged epoch4 FP32, preprocessing, valid GT[.1,1000]m, near<10m, GTevent<8m/drop2. Only validation. Eight configurations, no subsequent extensions. Original v1 preserved.
inputs: Current RGB vs last inferred RGB; zero-order-held simulated GPS velocity normalized separately (20m/s), consecutive simulated IMU accelerometer change (m/s2 proxy) and current gyro norm (rad/s proxy), previous predicted risk and age. No privileged GT velocity, GT depth/mask, future inputs. Ideal sensor availability assumed.
GPS_revision_before_search: User preferred causal GPS when available. Added the SAME GPS scale to all eight configurations before any search. Initial proposal preserved; no configurations added.
design_changes: Motion fix: separately normalized causal GPS/IMU proxies, removes privileged GT velocity and unchanging acceleration/gravity norm. Separate intentional RGB design change: current thumbnail compared to last inferred frame, whereas original compares immediately previous frame. Joint evaluation does not identify individual causal contributions.
